title: Resilience Initiative: Mosaic SLI Variance Tracker and Risk Triage
creator: Priya Patel
project: Reliability Initiative - SLO & Error Budget Orchestration
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight, per-initiative SLI variance tracker ("Mosaic") that surfaces where SLI volatility is driving error-budget burn and recommends immediate triage actions. The tracker should allow PMs and SREs to: 1) see normalized variance across routes/models/regions, 2) map variance to estimated error-budget minutes burned, 3) prioritize mitigation (scoped rollbacks, capacity shifts, throttles), and 4) feed signals into the initiative orchestration (auto-throttle/canary gating).

Why this work: We have observed that overall SLOs can look healthy while a small set of routes or model versions create most of the risk. Current dashboards are aggregate-first and make it hard to find the high-leverage surface area for intervention. Mosaic will reduce mean-time-to-triage and make error-budget governance actionable across Dedicated and Hosted customers.

Scope: Producer-facing console view + Grafana-like summary, a backend job that computes per-route per-window SLI variance and burn estimates, and a lightweight API for automation to consume triage recommendations. MVP excludes automated rollback execution; it will provide recommended actions and a one-click incident creation link.

Out of scope: full automation of capacity rebalancing, per-customer PCI-level audits.

Success metrics: time-to-first-action after error-budget alert reduced by 40% in pilot teams; 30% fewer P0 reliability incidents caused by undetected route-level variance within quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new 'Mosaic SLI Variance' card that can filter by model, route, region, and time window and shows top 10 variance contributors
Backend: nightly job that computes 1h/6h/24h variance and assigns estimated error-budget minutes burned per contributor
Alerting: alert rule that fires when a contributor accounts for >25% of monthly burn and variance >3x baseline
Playbook: triage flow linked from the console card that recommends action (canary rollback, route throttling, capacity redistribution) and creates a pre-populated incident template
Integration: Mosaic API endpoint that returns JSON recommendations and a severity score for automation consumers
Documentation: Confluence PRD and runbook with on-call steps, ownership, and escalation matrix
